data.one_liner: Contextual popup menus with different shapes, animations, and custom widget entries.
data.what_it_does: Attaches a customizable popup menu to any widget, supporting linear, circle, and grid layouts. It allows fine-tuning of animations, positions, and boundary checks, with menu entries that can be almost any widget.
use_when: You need contextual popup menus with custom shapes like circles or grids.
You want flexible entry animations and positioning for popup options.
avoid_when: You just need a standard Material popup menu without custom shapes or advanced animations.
strengths: Supports multiple layout shapes (linear, circle, grid)
Highly customizable animations, durations, and boundaries
Can build items lazily at runtime
weaknesses: API might be complex for very simple contextual menu use cases
data.minimal_example:
StarMenu(
  params: StarMenuParameters(),
  items: entries,
  child: FloatingActionButton(
    onPressed: () {},
    child: Icon(Icons.looks_one),
  ),
)
